SELECT
-- 用户总数 COUNT(DISTINCT principal_name) AS total_user_count,
-- 截止昨天用户总数 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN create_time < CURDATE() THEN principal_name END) AS yesterday_total_user_count,
-- 截止上周用户总数 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN create_time < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) THEN principal_name END) AS last_week_total_user_count,
-- 当前活跃用户 COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN access_token_expires_at > NOW() THEN principal_name END) AS total_active_user_count,
-- 活跃会话数 COUNT(CASE WHEN refresh_token_expires_at > NOW() THEN 1 END) AS total_active_session_count,
-- 累计授权次数 COUNT(*) AS total_history_authorization_count FROM oauth2_authorization
registered_client_id IN
#{registeredClientId}
1 = 0

SELECT ds.stat_date AS stat_date,
-- 累计用户总数：截至 stat_date 当天结束时 COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.create_time < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN a.principal_name END), 0) AS total_user_count,
-- 当前活跃用户：在 stat_date 当天内，Access Token 处于有效期 COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.access_token_expires_at > ds.stat_date AND a.access_token_issued_at < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN a.principal_name END), 0) AS total_active_user_count,
-- 活跃会话数：在 stat_date 当天内，Refresh Token 处于有效期 COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.refresh_token_expires_at > ds.stat_date AND a.refresh_token_issued_at < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END), 0) AS total_active_session_count,
-- 累计授权次数：截至 stat_date 当天结束时 COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN a.create_time < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN 1 END), 0) AS total_history_authorization_count
FROM dim_date ds LEFT JOIN oauth2_authorization a ON
a.registered_client_id IN
#{registeredClientId}
1 = 0
AND a.create_time < ds.stat_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
-- 确定起始日期 (默认 CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY)
ds.stat_date >= #{startDate}
ds.stat_date >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 6 DAY
-- 确定截止日期 (默认 CURDATE()) AND
ds.stat_date <= #{endDate}
ds.stat_date <= CURDATE()
GROUP BY ds.stat_date ORDER BY ds.stat_date ASC
